title: Peer entity-delivery accounting and same-lineage browser route
mode: Primary-source research and local plan crosswalk; research only
scope: Refresh ACadSharp retained-proxy and TArch report status
Separate parser notifications/counts from final entity and owner-collection publication
Classify browser/WASM routes by parser lineage and artifact scope
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 composed identity/owner-closure evidence without adding a new subplan

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1131
sources.observed: The thread includes a report that 56 DWG entity-mode notices were emitted as unknown entities while zero UnknownEntity records appeared in the final document. The commenter attributes this to model/paper-space staging lists not being consumed by that DWG path. This is peer-reported and not independently reproduced here. The later TArch discussion uses a user-provided native drawing and vendor-specific analysis, so it is not a general libdxfrw support requirement.

sources.name: ACadSharp proxy-data PR #1274
sources.observed: Merged as c9cb845 on 2026-10-13. The contributor reports equal entity counts and type/handle fingerprints over 21 DWGs (1,607,215 entities) and 2,358 retained proxy-data bytes. The PR discussion says no proxy regression drawing was committed because the available files were large and permission-sensitive. Treat this as route-specific author-reported traversal evidence, not an independent run or semantic support result.

sources.name: ACadSharp TArch PR #1275
sources.observed: Still open in the reviewed page. It proposes interpretation of a narrow native TArch text-object family and compares against the vendor's flattened T3 export. That same-producer comparison does not qualify general custom-entity semantics or libdxfrw.

sources.name: @mlightcad/libdxfrw-web package
sources.observed: The package describes itself as a WebAssembly version of libdxfrw, claims ASCII/Binary DXF read/write and DWG reading through AutoCAD 2020, and links to github.com/mlight-lee/libdxfrw. It is a same-family port/artifact, not an independent codec comparator.

sources.name: flyfish-dev/cad-viewer
sources.observed: The project documents DWG parsing through LibreDWG WebAssembly in a worker and DXF through a JavaScript parser/fallback. The two parser routes are attributable to those dependencies; renderer, worker, cancellation, and UI behavior are application evidence, not additional parser votes.

assessment.planImpact: Attach a per-handle source identity, parser disposition, and final owner/container membership ledger to the existing PAR-07/S8 composed evidence checkpoint. Aggregate callback/entity totals alone do not prove publication or owner closure. Keep same-lineage ports deduplicated and vendor-specific TArch interpretation outside scope. No per-slice full suite, peer runtime, fixture, or new support claim is required.

method.webReview: Primary GitHub issue/PR pages, project README, and npm package metadata; no peer artifact execution
method.localReview: Read-only plan and DWG reader/test source inspection
validation: git diff --check -- DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md passed after plan update
method.limitations: Peer-reported findings and contributor test counts were not reproduced. The optional browser route is same-lineage or dependency-routed, not independent semantic evidence. No claim is made about TArch support or general unknown-object preservation.
